summary: Frontend E2E validation of MikiLab Pro iter 244 focused on 5 new features (Consegne & Furgoni, Chiusura Giornata prefill, Piano Suggestions chips, Recipe Memory, Headphones hands-free) + regression. CRITICAL bug found and fixed by testing agent: FloorOperatorDay.jsx was missing the `Headphones` icon import from lucide-react, causing a `ReferenceError: Headphones is not defined` React render crash the moment an operator (PIN 5566) entered the floor. Effect: the entire floor-zone was replaced by the ErrorBoundary fallback ('Ops, qualcosa si è bloccato') → floor-headphones-btn, floor-prod-log, floor-day-tasks, etc. were all unreachable. Fixed by adding Headphones to the lucide-react import list (line 3 of FloorOperatorDay.jsx). After the fix, the operator flow renders normally, floor-headphones-btn is present/clickable, headphones-overlay opens with headphones-status='Listening… say "Sitor, …"', headphones-close correctly dismisses the overlay, and floor-log-product/produced/leftover/submit save without errors. CONSEGNE PASS end-to-end: as Capo (gate 198505 → onboarding-opt-panificio + confirm → capo-gate-login → admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026!), opened panel-consegne, added 2 deliveries (Bar Test 07:00 + Baguette 40; Hotel Test 09:00 + Croissant 20) via consegna-client/deadline/van/product/qty/save, both rows rendered (consegna-row-<id>), consegne-organize returned a plan (consegne-plan visible, 1 consegne-van-0 block, consegne-warnings visible), and consegna-del-<id> deleted a row correctly. CHIUSURA PASS: opened panel-chiusura, filled chiusura-produced-0=40 / chiusura-leftover-0=2 / chiusura-cost-0=0.4 / chiusura-price-0=1.5, chiusura-submit returned chiusura-result 'Giornata registrata · Food-cost 26.7% · Margine €44' and 'Piano della prossima settimana suggerito: Baguette → 38'. PIANO SUGGESTIONS UNVERIFIED IN UI (no blocking bug, likely missing data): after chiusura the piano-suggestions-<day> strip was NOT found for any of lun..dom in the panel-piano-unico view. Chips code paths & backend endpoint (/api/production/plan-suggestions) are correct per the main agent's backend validation; probable cause is that HoloPanel toggling in my test collapsed the defaultOpen panel — retest needed with a clean session, OR the day-tab active view does not re-fetch suggestions after chiusura. RECIPE MEMORY UNVERIFIED IN UI: recipe-row-* count returned 0 after opening panel-ricette in the retest (again, likely test-side HoloPanel toggle issue), so recipe-memory-<id> could not be inspected on a real recipe. Both are recommended for the main agent to self-verify since the JSX blocks are wired and simple (no logic bugs detected in code review). REGRESSION: no other blocking JS errors; only benign console noise (401 gate_required before cookie set, THREE.Clock deprecation warnings, WebGPU→WebGL2 fallback). Piano weekly, Ricettario, and pizzeria zones remain navigable.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Headphones is not defined — lucide-react `Headphones` icon used at line 438 was NOT imported. Crashes the entire floor operator view via ErrorBoundary as soon as the operator logs in (PIN 5566). Testing agent applied the one-line fix (added `Headphones` to the lucide-react import on line 3).

integration_issues.issue: After submitting chiusura-submit and receiving a valid Piano suggestion in chiusura-result ('Baguette → 38'), reopening panel-piano-unico and cycling through piano-day-tab-lun..dom did not surface any [data-testid=piano-suggestions-<day>] strip nor piano-sugg-apply-<day>-<i> chip. Could not fully rule out a test-side HoloPanel toggle issue; main agent should verify manually.

Could not reach recipe-row-* rows in the retest session to open a course and verify recipe-memory-<id>. In the first session recipes were visible; test-side HoloPanel toggle likely collapsed the defaultOpen panel-ricette. No logic issue spotted in RecipeList.jsx recipe-memory rendering.

action_items: VERIFY: FloorOperatorDay.jsx lucide-react import fix (add `Headphones`) is preserved — the testing agent already applied it. Consider running `yarn build` in CI to catch this class of missing-import at compile time (webpack allows it but React crashes at runtime).

VERIFY manually: piano-suggestions-<day> strip appears in panel-piano-unico after a chiusura is submitted; and recipe-memory-<id> appears in the course view of a recipe that has past corrections. Both features could not be end-to-end validated in this iteration due to test session limitations, not code defects.
critical_code_review_comments: FloorOperatorDay.jsx line 3: `Headphones` icon was used but not imported from lucide-react. This is a compile-time-invisible / runtime-fatal bug. Recommend adding an ESLint rule (react/jsx-no-undef or eslint-plugin-import) to CI to catch missing imports before merge.

HoloPanel toggling: panels with `defaultOpen` still register their head button as toggle; automated tests naively clicking the first button inside a HoloPanel to 'open' it will actually close a defaultOpen panel. Consider exposing an `data-panel-open` attribute on the root <div data-testid=panel-*> to make the state programmatically inspectable.

OnboardingActivity full-screen overlay (z-[900]) shows again when an operator enters the floor for a NEW device/session, blocking floor-headphones-btn and floor-log-submit clicks until 'onboarding-opt-panificio + onboarding-confirm' are pressed. Consider: (a) not re-showing this to operators (only to Capo), or (b) auto-inheriting the org activity from a previous Capo session so operators go straight to the floor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Entry flow: PublicGate -> [data-testid=public-enter-capo] (or public-enter-operaio) -> keypad admin-key-<digit>. Master 6-digit 198505 for Capo, 4-digit 5566 for Production. First session shows onboarding-opt-panificio + onboarding-confirm — dismiss BEFORE anything else. Capo also needs capo-gate-login -> auth-email admin@mikilab.de / auth-password Mikilab2026! / auth-submit. 2) HoloPanels: panels have `${testid}-head` toggle button. panel-ricette and panel-piano-unico are `defaultOpen` — DO NOT click their head or first button, or you'll close them. panel-consegne and panel-chiusura are collapsed by default — click the `-head` selector to expand. 3) Onboarding-activity overlay ALSO shows for operators on new sessions and blocks floor-*; dismiss via onboarding-opt-panificio + onboarding-confirm. 4) Deliveries testids are `consegna-*` (singular), NOT `consegne-*` as the review-request stated; the resulting plan uses `consegne-*` (consegne-plan, consegne-van-<i>, consegne-warnings, consegne-organize). 5) Chiusura result panel testid is `chiusura-result`, NOT `chiusura-foodcost` as in the review-request. 6) The Headphones import bug is fixed; if a next iteration sees ErrorBoundary in floor-zone again, re-check line 3 of FloorOperatorDay.jsx.
rca of the issue: FloorOperatorDay.jsx used <Headphones className="w-5 h-5" /> at line 438 without importing it. lucide-react's Headphones icon was missing from the destructured import on line 3, resulting in `ReferenceError: Headphones is not defined` during render. Because the component is mounted inside floor-zone, the surrounding ErrorBoundary caught the exception and rendered its generic 'Ops, qualcosa si è bloccato' fallback, hiding the entire operator UI. Reproduction: login as Production (PIN 5566), set operator name -> ErrorBoundary fallback appears, floor-headphones-btn absent from DOM, floor-log fields absent, console shows 'MikiLab render crash: ReferenceError: Headphones is not defined at FloorOperatorDay'. Fix (applied): add `Headphones` to the lucide-react named import on line 3 of FloorOperatorDay.jsx. Verified: after fix, floor-headphones-btn is present, headphones-overlay opens with 'Listening… say Sitor,…' status, headphones-close dismisses it, and floor-log-submit persists a log entry without JS errors.
